exposure: gestational age (37 weeks, 38 weeks, 39 weeks, 40 weeks)
cohort: 220 neonates born between 37 0/7 and 40 6/7 weeks of gestation.
finding: Neonatal morbidity, NICU admission and respiratory morbidity were higher in early term babies compared to full term babies.
mod_finding: Respiratory morbidity was higher at 37 weeks than 39 weeks regardless of mode of delivery.
